subject: Brightpath SOC 2: VM evidence & CVE remediation attestation
messages:
From: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@brightpath.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Brightpath Security Portal <security@brightpath.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 request: vulnerability management evidence + CVE attestation

Hi Mateo,

As part of our SOC 2 renewal questionnaire we need evidence of your vulnerability management cadence and a remediation attestation for a handful of tracked CVEs (including CVE-2026-9876 affecting a 3rd-party dependency). Could you provide: 

- A copy of your current VM cadence (scan frequency by environment) and SLA tiers for remediation (critical/high/med/low)
- Proof of remediation or compensating controls for CVE-2026-9876 and any related open findings
- A signed attestation on Redwood letterhead stating your remediation SLAs and ownership commitments for the next 12 months

Preferred formats: CSV or XLS for scan exports, PDF for attestation. Our deadline for the SOC 2 packet is 2026-12-15—can you confirm?

Thanks,
Olivia
Olivia Turner
Security Manager, Brightpath Finance
--
Brightpath Security Portal: https://portal.brightpath.com/
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@brightpath.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 3 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 request: vulnerability management evidence + CVE attestation

Hi Olivia — thank you for the clear list. We can meet your deadline. Attached are two artefacts I’m starting with: an XLS export of our recommended SLA matrix and a consolidated patch log (PDF) covering the last quarter.

Quick summary of our VM program (short form):
- Scan cadence: infra/staging: daily authenticated scans; production: weekly authenticated scans; container images: per-build scan; external-facing assets: continuous passive monitoring + weekly active scans.
- Remediation SLA (proposed, per your ask): critical: 72 hours to mitigation plan + 30 days to fix or compensating control; high: 14 days; medium: 45 days; low: 90 days.
- CVE triage: automated enrichment + manual owner assignment within 8 business hours for critical/high findings.

Specific to CVE-2026-9876: our dependency team deployed a compensating WAF rule on 2026-11-20 and a library patch was verified in canary on 2026-11-28 and rolled to full production on 2026-12-01. Evidence included in patch-log-202609-202612.pdf.

What I can provide next if helpful:
- Signed attestation PDF on Redwood letterhead (happy to route to legal for signature)
- Raw scan exports (CSV) per environment or a combined XLS — which do you prefer?
- A short letter describing compensating controls and a timeline for any residual items

Please confirm formats and whether you need independent scan results from a 3rd-party scanner; we can schedule a limited scan window.

Regards,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attach: redwood-vm-sla-matrix-20261203.xlsx; patch-log-202609-202612.pdf
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@brightpath.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 3 Dec 2026 14:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 request: vulnerability management evidence + CVE attestation

Hi all — adding a bit of technical detail from Security Ops so Brightpath has what you need for the SOC 2 packet.

1) Link to evidence bucket (read-only for Brightpath): https://drive.redwood.com/shared/brightpath/vm-evidence — contains:
   - authenticated-scan-prod-20261201.csv
   - authenticated-scan-staging-20261201.csv
   - container-scan-20261130.csv

2) Patching and verification notes for CVE-2026-9876:
   - 2026-11-18: vulnerability reported via OSS advisory
   - 2026-11-19: automated fingerprinting confirmed presence in two services (svc-a, svc-b)
   - 2026-11-20: temporary WAF rule deployed (mitigates exploitation vector)
   - 2026-11-24: patch tested in canary (smoke and integration tests)
   - 2026-11-28: patch promoted to canary-wide verification
   - 2026-12-01: production rollout completed; post-rollout scan (auth) shows no remaining affected instances

3) Evidence of mitigation included: patch-runner logs, deploy manifests, post-patch scan exports. We can provide signed checksums of the deploy artifacts if Brightpath needs cryptographic proof.

4) On third-party scans: we can permit a scoped external scan for your assessor and provide a short POC window (typically 48 hours). Please send the scanner IP ranges and desired scan start time; we require a short pre-scan coordination call.

If you want a single-page attestation summarizing the SLAs and ownership (for SOC 2 auditor intake), I can draft the security-ops-approved wording and route for legal sign-off.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Head of Security Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@brightpath.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Brightpath Security Portal <security@brightpath.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Dec 2026 15:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 request: vulnerability management evidence + CVE attestation

Hi Mateo / Kim — this is great, thank you. The evidence bucket and the patch log cover what our auditor requested. A couple of follow-ups before we close: 

1) We would like a signed attestation PDF showing the SLA table and an explicit statement that CVE-2026-9876 was remediated in production on 2026-12-01. Please include the name and title of the Redwoods signatory.
2) Brightpath prefers an independent scan result for critical/high items. We'll schedule a scoped external authenticated scan for 2026-12-10; please confirm you can open the window and provide the scanner IP allowlist and contact for coordination.

If you can get the attestation and the IP allowlist by EOD 2026-12-08 we should be on track for our 12-15 packet deadline.

Thanks again — Olivia
Olivia Turner
Security Manager, Brightpath Finance
